verses.original: כִּֽי־ תֵצֵ֨א לַמִּלְחָמָ֜ה עַל־ אֹיְבֶ֗יךָ וְֽרָאִ֜יתָ ס֤וּס וָרֶ֙כֶב֙ עַ֚ם רַ֣ב מִמְּךָ֔ לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א מֵהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ הַמַּֽעַלְךָ֖ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯê·ṣê lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘al- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā wə·rā·’î·ṯā sūs wā·re·ḵeḇ ‘am raḇ mim·mə·ḵā lō ṯî·rā mê·hem kî- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ‘im·māḵ ham·ma·‘al·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: When you go out to war against your enemies and see horses chariots and an army larger than yours do not be afraid of them for the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt is with you
verses.literalPt: Quando saíres à peleja contra os teus inimigos e vires cavalos, e carros, e povo mais numeroso do que tu, não terás medo deles; porque está contigo Jeová, teu Deus, que te fez subir da terra do Egito.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֕ה כְּקָֽרָבְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִגַּ֥שׁ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְדִבֶּ֥ר אֶל־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·qā·rā·ḇə·ḵem ’el- ham·mil·ḥā·māh wə·nig·gaš hak·kō·hên wə·ḏib·ber ’el- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: When you are about to go into battle the priest is to come forward and address . . . the army
verses.literalPt: Quando estiveres para entrar na peleja, o sacerdote se chegará, e falará ao povo,

verses.original: וְאָמַ֤ר אֲלֵהֶם֙ שְׁמַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתֶּ֨ם קְרֵבִ֥ים הַיּ֛וֹם לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עַל־ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם אַל־ יֵרַ֣ךְ לְבַבְכֶ֗ם אַל־ תִּֽירְא֧וּ וְאַֽל־ תַּחְפְּז֛וּ וְאַל־ תַּֽעַרְצ֖וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar ’ă·lê·hem šə·ma‘ yiś·rā·’êl ’at·tem qə·rê·ḇîm hay·yō·wm lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘al- ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem ’al- yê·raḵ lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem ’al- tî·rə·’ū wə·’al- taḥ·pə·zū wə·’al- ta·‘ar·ṣū mip·pə·nê·hem
verses.literal: saying to them Hear O Israel today you are going into battle with your enemies Do not be fainthearted . . . or afraid do not be alarmed . . . or terrified because of them
verses.literalPt: e lhe dirá: Ouvi, ó Israel, vós estais hoje para entrardes na peleja contra os vossos inimigos. Não se amoleça o vosso coração; não tenhais medo, nem tremais, nem vos atemorizeis por causa deles,

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ עִמָּכֶ֑ם לְהִלָּחֵ֥ם לָכֶ֛ם עִם־ אֹיְבֵיכֶ֖ם לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ha·hō·lêḵ ‘im·mā·ḵem lə·hil·lā·ḥêm lā·ḵem ‘im- ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: For the LORD your God goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to give you the victory
verses.literalPt: porque Jeová, vosso Deus, é quem vai convosco a pelejar por vós contra os vossos inimigos, para vos salvar.

verses.original: וְדִבְּר֣וּ הַשֹּֽׁטְרִים֮ אֶל־ הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹר֒ מִֽי־ הָאִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֤ה בַֽיִת־ חָדָשׁ֙ וְלֹ֣א חֲנָכ֔וֹ יֵלֵ֖ךְ וְיָשֹׁ֣ב לְבֵית֑וֹ פֶּן־ יָמוּת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְאִ֥ישׁ אַחֵ֖ר יַחְנְכֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏib·bə·rū haš·šō·ṭə·rîm ’el- hā·‘ām lê·mōr mî- hā·’îš ’ă·šer bā·nāh ḇa·yiṯ- ḥā·ḏāš wə·lō ḥă·nā·ḵōw yê·lêḵ wə·yā·šōḇ lə·ḇê·ṯōw pen- yā·mūṯ bam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·’îš ’a·ḥêr yaḥ·nə·ḵen·nū
verses.literal: Furthermore, the officers . . . are to address the army saying Has any man built a new house and not dedicated it Let him return . . . home or he may die in battle and another man dedicate it
verses.literalPt: Os oficiais dirão ao povo: Que homem há que tenha edificado uma casa nova e não a tenha dedicado? Vá-se e torne para sua casa, não suceda que morra na peleja, e outro homem a dedique.

verses.original: וּמִֽי־ הָאִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ נָטַ֥ע כֶּ֙רֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א חִלְּל֔וֹ יֵלֵ֖ךְ וְיָשֹׁ֣ב לְבֵית֑וֹ פֶּן־ יָמוּת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְאִ֥ישׁ אַחֵ֖ר יְחַלְּלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mî- hā·’îš ’ă·šer- nā·ṭa‘ ke·rem wə·lō ḥil·lə·lōw yê·lêḵ wə·yā·šōḇ lə·ḇê·ṯōw pen- yā·mūṯ bam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·’îš ’a·ḥêr yə·ḥal·lə·len·nū
verses.literal: Has any man planted a vineyard and not begun to enjoy its fruit Let him return . . . home or he may die in battle and another man enjoy its fruit
verses.literalPt: Que homem há que tenha plantado uma vinha, e não a tenha desfrutado? Vá-se e torne para sua casa, não suceda que morra na peleja, e outro homem a desfrute.

verses.original: וּמִֽי־ הָאִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ אֵרַ֤שׂ אִשָּׁה֙ וְלֹ֣א לְקָחָ֔הּ יֵלֵ֖ךְ וְיָשֹׁ֣ב לְבֵית֑וֹ פֶּן־ יָמוּת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְאִ֥ישׁ אַחֵ֖ר יִקָּחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mî- hā·’îš ’ă·šer- ’ê·raś ’iš·šāh wə·lō lə·qā·ḥāh yê·lêḵ wə·yā·šōḇ lə·ḇê·ṯōw pen- yā·mūṯ bam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·’îš ’a·ḥêr yiq·qā·ḥen·nāh
verses.literal: Has any man become pledged to a woman and not married her Let him return . . . home or he may die in battle and another man marry her
verses.literalPt: Que homem há que se tenha desposado com uma mulher e não a tenha recebido? Vá-se e torne para sua casa, não suceda que morra na peleja, e outro homem a receba.

verses.original: וְיָסְפ֣וּ הַשֹּׁטְרִים֮ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ הָעָם֒ וְאָמְר֗וּ מִי־ הָאִ֤ישׁ הַיָּרֵא֙ וְרַ֣ךְ הַלֵּבָ֔ב יֵלֵ֖ךְ וְיָשֹׁ֣ב לְבֵית֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יִמַּ֛ס אֶת־ לְבַ֥ב אֶחָ֖יו כִּלְבָבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·sə·p̄ū haš·šō·ṭə·rîm lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mə·rū mî- hā·’îš hay·yā·rê wə·raḵ hal·lê·ḇāḇ yê·lêḵ wə·yā·šōḇ lə·ḇê·ṯōw wə·lō yim·mas ’eṯ- lə·ḇaḇ ’e·ḥāw kil·ḇā·ḇōw
verses.literal: Then the officers shall speak further to the army saying Is any man afraid or fainthearted . . . Let him return . . . home so that the hearts of his brothers will not melt like his own
verses.literalPt: Dirão mais os oficiais ao povo: Que homem há que seja medroso e de coração tímido? Vá-se e torne para sua casa, não suceda que se derreta o coração de seus irmãos como o seu coração.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֛ה כְּכַלֹּ֥ת הַשֹּׁטְרִ֖ים לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם וּפָֽקְד֛וּ שָׂרֵ֥י צְבָא֖וֹת בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הָעָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·ḵal·lōṯ haš·šō·ṭə·rîm lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- hā·‘ām ū·p̄ā·qə·ḏū śā·rê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ bə·rōš hā·‘ām
verses.literal: When the officers have finished addressing . . . the army they are to appoint commanders to lead it . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando os oficiais tiverem acabado de falar ao povo, designarão capitães das hostes, para estarem em frente do povo.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תִקְרַ֣ב אֶל־ עִ֔יר לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עָלֶ֑יהָ וְקָרָ֥אתָ אֵלֶ֖יהָ לְשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯiq·raḇ ’el- ‘îr lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ‘ā·le·hā wə·qā·rā·ṯā ’ê·le·hā lə·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: When you approach . . . a city to fight against it you are to make an offer . . . of peace
verses.literalPt: Quando te aproximares duma cidade para pelejar contra ela, oferecer-lhe-ás a paz.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ אִם־ שָׁל֣וֹם תַּֽעַנְךָ֔ וּפָתְחָ֖ה לָ֑ךְ וְהָיָ֞ה כָּל־ הָעָ֣ם הַנִּמְצָא־ בָ֗הּ יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֛ לָמַ֖ס וַעֲבָדֽוּךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- šā·lō·wm ta·‘an·ḵā ū·p̄ā·ṯə·ḥāh lāḵ wə·hā·yāh kāl- hā·‘ām han·nim·ṣā- ḇāh yih·yū lə·ḵā lā·mas wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏū·ḵā
verses.literal: If they accept your offer of peace and open their gates all the people there will become forced laborers to serve you
verses.literalPt: Se ela se submeter em paz e te abrir as portas, todo o povo que se achar nela será sujeito a trabalhos forçados e te servirá.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֤א תַשְׁלִים֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ וְעָשְׂתָ֥ה עִמְּךָ֖ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְצַרְתָּ֖ עָלֶֽיהָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯaš·lîm ‘im·māḵ wə·‘ā·śə·ṯāh ‘im·mə·ḵā mil·ḥā·māh wə·ṣar·tā ʿå̄·lɛ·hå̄
verses.literal: But if they refuse to make peace with you and wage war against you lay siege to that city
verses.literalPt: Se não fizer paz contigo, porém te fizer guerra, sitiá-la-ás.

verses.original: וּנְתָנָ֛הּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְהִכִּיתָ֥ אֶת־ כָּל־ זְכוּרָ֖הּ לְפִי־ חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯā·nāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·hik·kî·ṯā ’eṯ- kāl- zə·ḵū·rāh lə·p̄î- ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: When the LORD your God has delivered it into your hand you must put every male to the sword
verses.literalPt: Quando Jeová, teu Deus, a entregar nas tuas mãos, passarás ao fio da espada todos os homens que nela houver;

verses.original: רַ֣ק הַ֠נָּשִׁים וְהַטַּ֨ף וְהַבְּהֵמָ֜ה וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בָעִ֛יר כָּל־ שְׁלָלָ֖הּ תָּבֹ֣ז לָ֑ךְ וְאָֽכַלְתָּ֙ אֶת־ שְׁלַ֣ל אֹיְבֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: raq han·nā·šîm wə·haṭ·ṭap̄ wə·hab·bə·hê·māh wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yih·yeh ḇā·‘îr kāl- šə·lā·lāh tā·ḇōz lāḵ wə·’ā·ḵal·tā ’eṯ- šə·lal ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā ’ă·šer nā·ṯan Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lāḵ
verses.literal: But the women children livestock and whatever else is in the city all its spoil you may take as plunder and you shall use the spoil of your enemies that the LORD your God gives you
verses.literalPt: porém as mulheres, e os pequeninos, e o gado, e tudo o que estiver na cidade, todos os despojos dela, por presa tua os tomarás; e sustentar-te-ás dos despojos dos teus inimigos que Jeová, teu Deus, te deu.

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ לְכָל־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים הָרְחֹקֹ֥ת מִמְּךָ֖ מְאֹ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ מֵעָרֵ֥י הַגּֽוֹיִם־ הָאֵ֖לֶּה הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kên ta·‘ă·śeh lə·ḵāl he·‘ā·rîm hā·rə·ḥō·qōṯ mim·mə·ḵā mə·’ōḏ ’ă·šer lō- mê·‘ā·rê hag·gō·w·yim- hā·’êl·leh hên·nāh
verses.literal: This is how you are to treat all the cities that are far away from you . . . and do not belong to the . . . nations nearby
verses.literalPt: Assim farás a todas as cidades que estiverem mais longe de ti, que não são das cidades destas nações.

verses.original: רַ֗ק מֵעָרֵ֤י הָֽעַמִּים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָ֑ה לֹ֥א תְחַיֶּ֖ה כָּל־ נְשָׁמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: raq mê·‘ā·rê hā·‘am·mîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā na·ḥă·lāh lō ṯə·ḥay·yeh kāl- nə·šā·māh
verses.literal: However in the cities of the nations that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance you must not leave alive anything that breathes
verses.literalPt: Porém nas cidades destes povos que Jeová, teu Deus, te está dando por herança, nada que tem fôlego deixarás com vida,

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הַחֲרֵ֣ם תַּחֲרִימֵ֗ם הַחִתִּ֤י וְהָאֱמֹרִי֙ הַכְּנַעֲנִ֣י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ha·ḥă·rêm ta·ḥă·rî·mêm ha·ḥit·tî wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: For you must devote them to complete destruction . . . the Hittites Amorites Canaanites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites as the LORD your God has commanded you
verses.literalPt: mas destruí-lo-ás totalmente: aos heteus, aos amorreus, aos cananeus, aos ferezeus, aos heveus, aos jebuseus, como Jeová, teu Deus, te ordenou;

verses.original: לְמַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ יְלַמְּד֤וּ אֶתְכֶם֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּכֹל֙ תּֽוֹעֲבֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַחֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer lō- yə·lam·mə·ḏū ’eṯ·ḵem la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ḵōl tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū lê·lō·hê·hem wa·ḥă·ṭā·ṯem Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: so that they cannot teach you to do all the detestable things they do for their gods and so cause you to sin against the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: para que vos não ensinem a fazer segundo todas as suas abominações que fizeram aos seus deuses; e assim pecareis contra Jeová, vosso Deus.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תָצ֣וּר אֶל־ עִיר֩ יָמִ֨ים רַבִּ֜ים לְֽהִלָּחֵ֧ם עָלֶ֣יהָ לְתָפְשָׂ֗הּ לֹֽא־ תַשְׁחִ֤ית אֶת־ עֵצָהּ֙ לִנְדֹּ֤חַ עָלָיו֙ גַּרְזֶ֔ן כִּ֚י מִמֶּ֣נּוּ תֹאכֵ֔ל וְאֹת֖וֹ לֹ֣א תִכְרֹ֑ת כִּ֤י הָֽאָדָם֙ עֵ֣ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לָבֹ֥א מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ בַּמָּצֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯā·ṣūr ’el- ‘îr yā·mîm rab·bîm lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ‘ā·le·hā lə·ṯā·p̄ə·śāh lō- ṯaš·ḥîṯ ’eṯ- ‘ê·ṣāh lin·dō·aḥ ‘ā·lāw gar·zen kî mim·men·nū ṯō·ḵêl wə·’ō·ṯōw lō ṯiḵ·rōṯ kî hā·’ā·ḏām ‘êṣ haś·śā·ḏeh lā·ḇō mip·pā·ne·ḵā bam·mā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: When you lay siege to a city for an extended time while fighting against it to capture it you must not destroy its trees by putting an axe to them because you can eat their fruit - You must not cut them down . . . Are the trees of the field human that you should besiege them
verses.literalPt: Quando sitiares uma cidade por muito tempo, pelejando contra ela para a tomar, não destruirás o seu arvoredo, metendo nele o machado. Porque dele poderás comer, não o cortarás; pois é a árvore do campo homem, para que fosse sitiada por ti?

verses.original: רַ֞ק עֵ֣ץ אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּדַ֗ע כִּֽי־ לֹא־ עֵ֤ץ מַאֲכָל֙ ה֔וּא אֹת֥וֹ תַשְׁחִ֖ית וְכָרָ֑תָּ וּבָנִ֣יתָ מָצ֗וֹר עַל־ הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁר־ הִ֨וא עֹשָׂ֧ה עִמְּךָ֛ מִלְחָמָ֖ה עַ֥ד רִדְתָּֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: raq ‘êṣ ’ă·šer- tê·ḏa‘ kî- lō- ‘êṣ ma·’ă·ḵāl hū ’ō·ṯōw ṯaš·ḥîṯ wə·ḵā·rā·tā ū·ḇā·nî·ṯā mā·ṣō·wr ‘al- hā·‘îr ’ă·šer- hî ‘ō·śāh ‘im·mə·ḵā mil·ḥā·māh ‘aḏ riḏ·tāh
verses.literal: But you may destroy the trees that you know . . . do not . . . produce fruit . . . Use them to build siege works against the city that . . . is waging war against you until it falls
verses.literalPt: Somente as árvores cujos frutos souberes que não se comem, destruí-las-ás, e as cortarás, e, contra a cidade que pelejar contra ti, edificarás obras de sítio até que ela caia.
